scenarios.title: A new repo
scenarios.blurb: Nothing is written yet, so the loop grows with the code.
index: Created .cortex/ — generated artifacts live here; .cortex/memory/ is committed on purpose.

items.title: Greenfield repo — nothing to index yet

rows.title: intent/ — the home for the artifact chain
rows.why: an idea with no committed home is re-litigated every time it is raised

rows.title: The root brief — what a new joiner would need on day one
rows.why: no dependency manifest found, so the brief has to be written from the interview

rows.title: The agent team — one job per agent, each role picked on its own
rows.why: offers: architect, implementer, tester, reviewer — each picked on its own; project-manager waits: nothing to manage yet: no plan folder (intent/, docs/specs/ or docs/plans/)
needs: code in the repo — a team has nothing yet to plan, test or review

rows.title: The verification block — how Claude checks its own work
rows.why: greenfield, so the commands come from the interview rather than a manifest
needs: a declared build, test or lint command — the block must name real ones

rows.title: The verifier subagent — a fresh context window that checks the work
rows.why: no runnable command declared yet — a verdict from a fresh context is not coloured by the assumptions that produced the code
needs: a declared test or build command

rows.title: evals/ — regression tests for the agent's own configuration
rows.why: no CI detected is present — CLAUDE.md, skills and hooks steer the agent, so they deserve the regression testing code gets
needs: a CI system to run the suite
CLAUDE.md or AGENTS.md — the configuration an eval regresses against

rows.title: REVIEW.md — the review policy every PR is judged against
rows.why: no generated paths detected, so the exclusions list starts empty and grows
needs: code in the repo — there is nothing to write a review policy about yet

rows.title: cortex-review.yml — every PR read against the repo's own documents, in CI
rows.why: no CI detected, and a review that runs only when someone remembers it is the one that gets skipped
needs: GitHub Actions — the template is a GitHub workflow
AGENTS.md — the documents a pull request is reviewed against

rows.title: Hooks — the deterministic layer behind the advisory ones
rows.why: no generated paths and no declared formatter, so no hook has work to do here
needs: a generated path or lockfile to protect, or a declared formatter — without either, both hooks would do nothing

rows.title: bands.yaml — what closes the loop back to intent
rows.why: a breach with no review gate has nowhere safe to escalate, so this stays closed for now
needs: REVIEW.md — the gate a 3σ breach escalates into
a CI system to run the detection script
